description: Renames a schema via a directive. A schema is the one container a rename cannot move an object between, so it is the only rename with nowhere to hide: either the engine has one or the objects inside have to move.

sqlserver.because: SQL Server has no schema rename; moving a schema's contents is a transfer of every object, which NSchema.SqlServer does not perform.

sqlite.because: SQLite has no schema other than main, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
